text:
anya: FYI customer 'acme-app' reporting sudden org-admins after IdP changed group attribute. Ticket CS-9281. SCIM sync appears to map the new SAML attribute to the wrong role. Can we triage?

devon: tenant id? hosted/dedicated? any evidence of admin API calls?

anya: tenant: tenant-acme-42, hosted. Customer claims they rolled out an IdP change ~2024-11-05T14:10Z. We see provisioning logs showing a role mapping fallback at 2024-11-05T14:12Z. Audit shows several create/export calls from two users that became admin at ~14:13Z. We revoked sessions already.

jen: can you paste the SCIM patch and the SAML attribute assertion (redact user ids)? need repro steps to confirm connector behavior.

anya: SCIM patch snippet (redacted):

```
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/12345
{
  "Operations": [
    {"op":"replace", "path":"roles", "value":["org-admin"]}
  ]
}
```

And provisioning log: `WARN provisioning: attribute_missing roles -> applying default: org-admin`

Also SAML assertion sample shows attribute name changed from `urn:company:groups` -> `https://idp.example.com/claims/roles`. Customer says they updated mapping on IdP side and thought SCIM connector would map `roles` to our internal role labels.

provisioner-bot: connector-deploy: provisioning-connector v2.14.1 deployed by infra-deploy at 2024-11-05T13:58:02Z (commit fe3a9b).

eli: if users suddenly gained admin, we need to treat as potential security incident. Do we have KMS/HSM decrypt logs for tenant-acme-42 around 14:10-14:20Z? Might indicate bulk data access. Also, any export APIs hit?

raul: support already contacted customer to freeze sessions and rotate API keys. We rotated tenant-level API keys at 14:25Z. I can run a permissions sweep. Command I used internally: `rbac-scan --tenant tenant-acme-42 --role org-admin --since 2024-11-05T13:00Z` returned 6 principals that transitioned to org-admin after 14:11Z.

devon: short-term mitigation: enforce explicit role mapping on the tenant: set `scim.enforce_role_mapping = true` and add a deny-rule to block exports by principals with role_change_ts > 2024-11-05T14:00Z. Example policy snippet:

```json
{"policy":"deny", "action":"export:create","condition":{"role_history_changed_after":"2024-11-05T14:00:00Z"}}
```

jen: can ops apply that policy to tenant-acme-42? If yes, also capture a full audit export (events, scim logs, kms events) for compliance.

anya: applied `scim.enforce_role_mapping=true` and pushed the deny policy at 14:45Z. Initial telemetry shows no further admin-export calls. I exported the audit bundle to S3://redwood-incident-exports/CS-9281/ (access-limited).

eli: next steps from security: 1) collect KMS decrypt events for tenant key and HSM audit logs for 48h window, 2) preserve SCIM connector logs and IdP assertion samples, 3) determine if any data egress occurred (look at export/create and object-download events). If any data accessed, escalate and notify legal.

raul: collecting logs now, will attach to ticket. Quick note: provisioning log shows `attribute_missing` because our connector expected `urn:company:groups` attribute; IdP changed attribute name without notifying customer tenant admin. That caused mapping to fall back to default role mapping (default==org-admin for this tenant).

devon: long-term: we should add schema validation when scim connector first sees a new attribute name and alert tenant admins instead of silently falling back to default. File follow-up issue: RUN-PLATFORM-1203.

anya: customer requests summary and compliance proof that no sensitive PII was exported. I'll coordinate deliverables.

jen: action items: jen assign -> collect audit + KMS/HSM lines (jen), raul -> attach audit bundle & customer comms, devon -> platform follow-up PR for schema validation, eli -> lead security review and determine incident classification. Meeting scheduled 2024-11-06 10:00 PT.

eli: also recommend rotating tenant's KMS key if any decrypts were performed by principals after role change.

anya: noted, thanks everyone. marking as high priority. :warning:

jen: thanks team — we've applied mitigation and started forensics. Will update CS-9281 by EOD. :white_check_mark:
